offline_coordinate_alignment.purpose: geometry diagnosis only; never navigation or pose correction
offline_coordinate_alignment.primary: inverse frozen sensor yaw rotation plus native/body to SLAM/body position pairing at 6.8 s
offline_coordinate_alignment.current_query_geometry: 132 s actual accepted point_lidar transformed by 200 Hz native/body pose interpolation and measured lidar extrinsic; already estimator-undistorted points so this is an offline surface check with scan/motion uncertainty, not a replacement raw-cloud replay

analytic_lidar_sampling.method: No ROS/Gazebo replay: first intersection with static SDF visual boxes for actual native 3.7–6.0 s 10 Hz pose, 480x32 ideal beams; group hits inside historical leaf voxel using full attitude anchor; predicted ring groups are approximate because original pre-115 s input clouds and map-point list were not logged
analytic_lidar_sampling.moving_obstacle_assumption: SDF initial pose used for ray occlusion; no selected east-wall result relies on moving-obstacle face
analytic_lidar_sampling.single_trace_formula: For wall x=D, level lidar and a fixed elevation e: y=D*tan(a), z=z_lidar+D*tan(e)/cos(a). Within a small voxel this is a nearly one-dimensional curved scan trace; successive rings around 17 m are separated about 0.43 m. Range noise along the beam can exceed the tiny cross-trace curvature spread.
analytic_lidar_sampling.noise_mc_scope: fixed analytic candidate points plus independent Gaussian range noise, 200 trials with seed42; demonstrates mechanism plausibility, not original stochastic Gazebo map-building reproduction or AB fix validation; reported absdot-with-wall <=0.20 means near-orthogonal to the wall normal, not an independently tested |nz| production gate.

PCA_interpretation.eigenvalues_order: lambda0<=lambda1<=lambda2; covariance eigenvalues have unit m^2

exact_line_counterexample.nullspace_normals: any unit normal in x-z plane, including physical wall x normal and false horizontal z normal; both have identical zero residual

PCA_interpretation.actual_near_line: Historical eigenvalues are finite and the smallest eigenvector is algebraically unique where the eigengap is nonzero; this does not make that normal a reliable physical-surface normal. Very small lambda1/lambda2 signals poor two-dimensional support and sensitivity to scan-line curvature/noise/early motion.
PCA_interpretation.original_acceptance: init_plane checks only lambda0 < planer_threshold (0.005); lambda1 lower-bound code exists only as comments. A near-line cluster meets this criterion.
PCA_interpretation.freeze: max_points_num=50 disables later refits; saved plane has 48 points from last refit. Later broad 2D wall observations do not update it.
PCA_interpretation.uncertainty_caveat: lambda1/lambda2 is a diagnostic indicator, not a newly proposed universal production threshold; lambda0/lambda1, eigengap relative to range/angle uncertainty, 2D support, distance, normal consistency and non-frozen update behavior need controlled AB tests.

conclusions: Selected historical near-horizontal constraints correspond to the actual east vertical wall, independently verified by scene placement and actual accepted lidar-point/native geometry.
Historical near-line wall sampling accepted as planes, then frozen, is a direct contributor to the erroneous downward correction at 132 s; it is not a physical 20–34 cm body drop.

This is stronger than a generic SLAM-init or GPU-load guess, but one diagnostic run is not a controlled intervention: do not claim that a specific PCA/map-update fix is proven or that no other LIO/VIO issue contributes.
limits: Only the 210 s diagnostic prefix; original full-navigation acceptance remains failed.

Initial 3.7–6 s raw lidar/map-member points absent from detailed archive; historical eigenvalues/normal/count/refit times are exact saved values, while ring/range-noise simulation is an offline analytic plausibility check.
Primary frame comparison uses frozen yaw and early paired position; full-attitude anchor is a sensitivity check. Neither feeds online navigation.
No C++/runtime/old-camera modifications, no process signals, no new simulation run.
